ficha_publicada.complicacoes: Demonic Nature: Blaze is one of the spawn of Hell and is recognizable as such with the proper mystic senses. Uneasy Sits the Crown: Blaze’s position in Hell is always threatened. The only things that change are whether the threat is open or hidden and who happens to be behind it at any given time.
